title: Invalidate a pad's solder mask cache
summary: Shows the read-modify-assign pattern for a pad's V7_PadCache and the alternative IPCB_Pad.InvalidateCache, with before and after read-backs that reveal what PostProcess revalidates.
phrasings: change a pad cache field and assign it back
mark solder mask expansion as invalid on pads
read the cached solder mask and paste mask of a pad
make pads recalculate their rule values

commands.name: InvalidatePadSolderMaskCache
commands.description: Set SolderMaskExpansionValid to eCacheInvalid on the first pad (All=True: every pad) and report the cache before and after

commands.name: ReadPadCache
commands.description: Report the first pad's cache fields
